title: Acceptance probability under proof reindexing
statement: For every natural number $n$, every Boolean word $w\colon\operatorname{Fin}(n)\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, and every Boolean proof table $P\colon\operatorname{Fin}(2^n+2^{n^2})\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, the proof-function tester's acceptance probability on the word that equals $w$ on input coordinates and $P$ on proof coordinates is equal to the quadratic-character pair tester's acceptance probability on the oracle whose linear and matrix components are extracted from $P$.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ is a Boolean word indexed by $\operatorname{Fin}(n)$
$P$ is a Boolean proof table indexed by $\operatorname{Fin}(2^n+2^{n^2})$
